messages:
maria: heads up — staging promote failed during preflight: helm chart signature check failed on artifacts service.
deploy-bot: deploy attempt blocked: chart verification error (signature timestamp outside allowed window).
leo: logs? what error exactly?
ci-bot: error snippet: `ERROR: chart-signature: timestamp=2024-11-11T23:58:00Z, allowed-drift=300s, now=2024-11-12T00:04:45Z`
leo: ah looks like the signing key's clock drifted by ~6m, so verification rejects it.
sre-oncall: is this only for helm charts or artifacts in general?
ci-bot: currently failures observed for charts pushed between 23:56 and 23:59 UTC — container images and other artifacts fine.
james: did the signing job run on a different host? maybe NTP hiccup on the signer.
maria: release window is 00:00-04:00 UTC. This blocks the scheduled canary. Can we fallback to reusing last signed chart?
leo: we can pin to previous chart version (v1.12.3) for the canary to unblock, but that means code changes in the chart wouldn't be included.
sre-oncall: temporary plan: 1) pin canary to v1.12.3, 2) hold rollout for prod, 3) re-sign problematic charts after signer node is fixed, 4) perform manual promote and smoke test.
james: agree. who can re-run the signer? tagging infra: @leo can you check the signer instance and NTP?
leo: on it — looks like chronyd restarted during rotation. NTP drift fixed, re-sign job pending.
maria: timeline? we need to decide within the change window or postpone.
leo: estimated re-sign and re-upload ~20-30m assuming no further issues. If done before 00:40 UTC we can still run the canary later in the window.
sre-oncall: action: maria will pin canary to v1.12.3, create rollback note. leo will re-run signer and post artifacts URLs. james will prepare a manual promote playbook. i'll coordinate runbook and update incident channel.
maria: creating a quick PR to pin chart ref now.
ci-bot: PR created: https://git.internal/repo/infra/helm-charts/pull/542 — CI will run but chart-verifier will still fail for new charts until re-signing.
leo: re-signed charts uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/helm/2024-11-12/re-signed-3348907777.tgz — verification passes locally.
sre-oncall: running validation in staging now.
ci-bot: staging validation: all checks passed for re-signed chart.
maria: thanks. holding decision for prod promote until 00:50 UTC to watch metrics. if no regressions, manual promote at 01:00 UTC.
james: i'll be on call during promote and will document the manual steps in the release thread.
sre-oncall: raising a follow-up ticket to add a signer health check and alert on NTP drift.
maria: noted. adding to release notes: "Temporary canary pinned due to chart signing drift; full chart updated post re-signing". :memo:
leo: landing the signer fix and adding scheduled NTP check.
maria: closing loop here — canary pinned, re-sign done, staging validated, holding for manual prod promote at 01:00 UTC.
ci-bot: deploy-bot scheduled manual promote job at 01:00 UTC.
